description:
System Jobs Doctor helps Dynamics 365 / Dataverse developers, support teams and administrators understand why an asynchronous workflow or plug-in did not run, fix the stuck or failed system jobs, and clean up the system jobs table (asyncoperation), which often grows to millions of rows and consumes database storage.

Set a scope (period on the created, started or completed date, job type, regarding table, process name, statuses) and click Analyze. The dashboard shows exact server counts per status, the jobs over time and the breakdowns by status, type, table and process. Beyond the 50,000-row aggregate limit, the counts are computed by time slices planned from the table size and run in parallel.

Error messages are normalized (GUIDs, dates, numbers, URLs and record names removed) so that thousands of failures sharing the same cause appear as one error group, with the top 10 failing processes and their failure rate. Each job shows its regarding record, process, owner, dates, error code, full message and the plug-in trace logs sharing its correlation id. A text summary of a job or of all failed jobs, with a hint for the most common errors, is ready to paste in a ticket or an e-mail.

Bulk actions resume suspended and failed jobs (a failed workflow that the platform does not restart can be run again on its record), cancel, postpone or delete a selection or a whole error group, in ExecuteMultiple batches with a confirmation and a per-job error report. The storage cleanup page estimates the jobs and the space a rule would free, then creates a bulk deletion job in Dataverse, once or recurring. Everything can be exported to an Excel report.

A connection is needed. Nothing is loaded before you click Analyze, and long operations can be stopped. English and French interface.
releaseNotes:
1.0.0 - First release

- Scope: period with start and end dates on the created, started or completed date, job type, regarding table (picked in the list or typed), process name, statuses.
- Dashboard: exact server counts per status (time slices planned from the table size and counted in parallel beyond the 50,000-row aggregate limit), jobs over time, breakdowns by status, type, table and process; click a tile or a bar to list the jobs.
- Errors grouped by normalized cause (GUIDs, dates, numbers, URLs and names removed), top 10 failing processes with their failure rate, actions on a whole group.
- Job list: virtual grid for tens of thousands of jobs, search, sort, table filter; details with regarding record, process, owner, dates, retries, error code, correlation id and full message; links to the record, the system job and the process.
- Plug-in trace logs of a job (same correlation id or request id).
- Bulk actions in ExecuteMultiple batches: resume suspended and failed jobs (state checked afterwards, failed workflows run again on their record when needed), cancel, postpone, delete completed jobs; confirmation and error report.
- Summaries: summary of one job or of the failed jobs, with hints for common errors, to copy or save as text.
- Storage cleanup: row snapshot and size estimate, count of the whole table by status, cleanup rule estimate, bulk deletion job (once, daily, weekly or monthly) and the list of existing ones.
- Excel report: summary, top 10 failing processes, error groups, jobs, processes, tables and types.
- Modern loading overlay with progress, elapsed time and Stop button; English and French interface.
summary: Diagnose, fix and clean up Dataverse system jobs: exact counts, errors grouped by cause, plug-in trace logs, bulk resume / cancel / delete, bulk deletion job and Excel report.
title: System Jobs Doctor
